runs.content: Consumer staples led a defensive rotation out of AI and semiconductors on 10-22, and P&G's FY27 Q1 delivered volume-led +4% organic growth across all categories with guidance maintained, at ~22x forward earnings.

Elevance was bought on its Q3 beat-and-raise (adj. EPS $6.99 vs ~$4.70, FY26 guide ≥$29, ≥12% 2027 growth) at ~15x forward after a 1.4% dip on the print; managed care aligns with Burry's longs. BBW was exited as a capacity trim at $23.36 (−8.68%, −$87; weakest position, below its 52-week low). No stop/T1/T2 triggers. Turso CLI writes worked; 3 raw-SQL fixes (COP T1, MCK/AMAT dates) are still blocked. Portfolio net P&L: +$2,541 (+3.14% on $81,000).
